callSummary.title: Innovation Grant 2026 – Summary
callSummary.subtitle: Grants to businesses for modernization, energy efficiency and digitalization
callSummary.meta: Contoso – Incentives Department · Version 1.0 of 15 June 2026 · Fictional data and amounts
blocks: The Contoso Innovation Grant 2026 supports the investments of businesses that modernize machinery and plant, improve their energy efficiency and digitalize their processes. The total budget is EUR 12 million.
Businesses of any size can apply if, on the date of submission, they:
have at least one active operating site in Ireland;
are registered with the Companies Registration Office;
are tax compliant (valid Tax Clearance Certificate);
are not in liquidation, receivership or any other insolvency procedure.
Each business may submit only one application, for one intervention track only.
Replacement or upgrade of machinery; machinery-related solutions that reduce noise and vibration (soundproof booths, anti-vibration mounts, sound-absorbing panels); automation of production lines.
LED lighting; heat pumps; energy-monitoring systems; insulation of plant.
Management and planning software; IoT sensors; predictive maintenance; digital training of staff on the new tools.
purchase of new machinery, plant, equipment and software;
training of staff on the use of the purchased assets, up to 10% of the cost;
technical consultancy related to the project, up to 5% of the cost.
ordinary maintenance and replacement of spare parts;
VAT, unless it cannot be recovered by the business;
costs incurred before the date of submission of the application.
The grant is non-repayable and is calculated on the eligible costs net of VAT.

The minimum eligible cost of a project is €10,000. The grant can be combined with other aid only for different costs or, for the same costs, within 100% of the cost and within the limits of the de minimis regime (Form C).
within 12 months of the award of the grant
within 60 days of the completion of the project
The following documents must be attached to the application (detailed checks in the “Review procedure”):
Form A – Grant application, digitally signed;
quotes, at least one for each cost item;
company extract from the Companies Registration Office, not older than 6 months;
identity document of the legal representative;
bank details (IBAN) in the name of the business.

Applications are submitted only on the “Contoso Grants Online” portal, with the digital signature of the legal representative (CAdES .p7m or PAdES formats). Official communications take place through the registered e-mail address of the business. Documents sent by ordinary e-mail are not taken into account.
The Incentives Department replies within 5 working days. No preliminary opinions on the eligibility of projects are given.

callFaq.title: FAQ – Innovation Grant 2026
callFaq.subtitle: Frequently asked questions from businesses
callFaq.meta: Contoso – Incentives Department · Update of 20 September 2026 · Fictional content
blocks: FAQ 1 – Is a project to modernize machinery, for example to reduce the noise in the workshop, eligible?

Yes. It falls under Track 1 “Modernization of machinery and plant” if it includes the replacement or upgrade of machinery or machinery-related solutions that reduce noise and vibration (soundproof booths, anti-vibration mounts, sound-absorbing panels). Ordinary maintenance alone is not eligible.
Yes. Micro and small businesses receive a grant of 70% of the eligible costs, instead of the 60% for medium and large businesses, always within the maximum of the track.
FAQ 3 – Can the grant be combined with other incentives?
Yes, with other aid for different costs. For the same costs, combining is allowed within 100% of the cost and within the limits of the de minimis regime, to be declared in Form C.
FAQ 4 – How and by when are the quotes uploaded?

On the “Contoso Grants Online” portal, “Documents” section, as PDF files digitally signed by the legal representative, at most 10 MB per file, by 30 November 2026 at 18:00. Any extension is decided only by circular.
FAQ 5 – Is the digital signature mandatory?
Yes, for Forms A, B and C and for the quotes. CAdES (.p7m) and PAdES (signed PDF) formats are accepted.
FAQ 6 – Are extensions of the deadlines possible?
Extensions are decided only by a circular of the Incentives Department, published in the “Circulars” section of the portal. Informal communications have no value.
FAQ 7 – How is the project reported?

Within 60 days of the completion of the project, and in any case within 12 months of the award, the business uploads invoices, traceable payment receipts, a final report and photos of the installed assets. The payment is made within 90 days of the approval of the report.
FAQ 8 – Who can I contact for information?
Write to innovation-grant@contoso.example or call +353 1 000 0000 (Monday–Friday, 9:00–13:00). The answer arrives within 5 working days. No preliminary opinions on eligibility are given.

reviewProcedure.title: Review procedure for the applications
reviewProcedure.subtitle: Innovation Grant 2026 – phases, document checklist and consistency checks
reviewProcedure.meta: Contoso – Incentives Department · Internal procedure no. RP-07 · Version 1.2 of 1 September 2026 · Fictional content
blocks: The procedure describes how the reviewing case officers examine the Innovation Grant 2026 applications, from receipt to the proposal of the outcome, and which documents and consistency checks are mandatory.
**Admissibility** (within 10 working days of submission): application submitted on time, on the portal, with a valid digital signature.
**Eligibility**: requirements of the applicant (Summary §2) and consistency of the project with the chosen track (Summary §3).
**Document check**: check of the 10 documents of the checklist (§3) and of the consistency checks (§4).
**Request for additional documents**: if documents are missing or there are inconsistencies, the case officer sends a request by registered e-mail; the business has 10 days to reply.
**Technical assessment**: score out of 100 points (project quality 40, impact 30, economic sustainability 20, schedule 10).
**Proposed outcome**: the reviewing case officer drafts the reasoned proposal.
**Decision**: the director of the Incentives Department approves or rejects; the outcome is communicated by registered e-mail.
Digital signature of the legal representative; version 2.1 (2.0 accepted until 15 October 2026); grant requested consistent with costs and rate.
Complete in every field, registered e-mail given (mandatory from version 2.1), digitally signed.
Aid of the current and the two previous financial years; digitally signed.
Track, objectives, assets to purchase, expected results.
In the name of the business; VAT shown separately; not older than 6 months before submission; signed; sum of the net amounts equal to the cost in Form A.
Not older than 6 months; VAT number and site consistent with Form A.
Identity document of the legal representative
Valid on the date of submission.
Activities and dates compatible with completion within 12 months.
Account in the name of the applicant business.
**Dates**: quotes, company extract and Tax Clearance Certificate within their validity; no cost before submission.
**Amounts**: grant requested = eligible cost × rate of the business (70% micro and small, 60% medium and large), rounded to the euro and within the maximum of the track.
**Signatures**: valid digital signatures of the legal representative shown in the company extract.
Subject: Innovation Grant 2026 – Application <number> – Request for additional documents

With reference to the application above, please send through the “Contoso Grants Online” portal, within 10 days of receipt of this letter, the following documents or clarifications: <list>. Without a reply, the application will be assessed on the basis of the available documents.
Kind regards – The reviewing case officer, Contoso – Incentives Department

The decision on eligibility always belongs to the reviewing case officer and to the director. Automated support tools can only collect evidence and propose texts: they do not decide the outcome of the applications.

circular1.title: Circular no. 1/2026 of 10 September 2026
circular1.subtitle: Subject: Innovation Grant 2026 – how to upload the documents
circular1.meta: Contoso – Incentives Department · Addressed to: staff of the Incentives Department and offices · Fictional content
blocks: In order to harmonize the handling of the Innovation Grant 2026 applications, the following is established.
**Deadline for supplementary quotes**: supplementary quotes can be uploaded on the “Contoso Grants Online” portal by **30 November 2026, 18:00**.
**Format**: every document must be uploaded as a PDF file, with a maximum size of **10 MB per file**.
**Signature**: quotes must be digitally signed by the legal representative of the business.
**Channels**: documents sent by ordinary or registered e-mail are not considered; only the upload on the portal counts.
This circular applies from the date of its publication.
The Director of the Incentives Department

circular2.title: Circular no. 2/2026 of 22 September 2026
circular2.subtitle: Subject: Innovation Grant 2026 – extension of the deadline for uploading supplementary quotes
circular2.meta: Contoso – Incentives Department · Addressed to: staff of the Incentives Department and offices · Fictional content
blocks: Following extraordinary maintenance of the “Contoso Grants Online” portal, the following is established.
The deadline for uploading supplementary quotes set in point 1 of Circular no. 1/2026 is **extended to 15 December 2026, 18:00**.
The maximum file size is **raised to 20 MB per file**.
The other provisions of Circular no. 1/2026 (digital signature, file names, channels) are unchanged.
The extension does **not** concern the deadline for submitting the applications, which remains 30 October 2026, 18:00.
The offices are invited to inform the businesses that have already contacted them.
The Director of the Incentives Department
